items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: He had Frankie Newton and Manzie Johnson and some of the guys.

ctx.x: know. You have so many promises down through life. You get so it just goes in one ear and out the other. So, sure enough, they set it up. The guy come down to listen to us, and they said all right, on the 4th of February you open. Well, this is about December, or November, it could have been, the last part of November, the first part of December, and they were setting this up. So when we got ready to go to the Onyx, but then we kind of backed out, because the manager of the Onyx -- I mean the manager of the…

So now Stuff says, "Okay, that's a good idea." Everything was all right with Stuff. You know how he was. And so he come on down and he got a band together. He had Frankie Newton and Manzie Johnson and some of the guys. So about -- and he started rehearsing them. And about two weeks before opening, why Joe talked to him and says, "Is all the fellows in town?" So he says, "No, they're not coming. I'm going to use another group." So Joe Helbluth (PHONETIC) says, "Oh,

no." He says, "I want that same group I heard. I don't want no other group." Now, we had already signed a contract with this guy. His name was Toppey, in Buffalo, you know. And so Stuff says, "They're not coming, but I've got a better group." So Joe Helbluth said, "I don't want no better group. I want the same group I heard and the same guys." So he said, "Well, they won't come." So he said, "Well, we'll get them down here." "So forget about what you're rehearsing now."
